headline: Mexican Stock Benchmark Drops 3.6% in Worst Weekly Performance Since August
summary: Mexico's main stock index fell 3.62% over four trading sessions, marking its worst weekly performance since August, while the Mexican peso depreciated 3.3% against the US dollar.
why: The S&P/BMV IPC is Mexico's flagship benchmark index tracking top companies listed on the Bolsa Mexicana de Valores.
